相等的；对等之物（仅作概念对照，非本词词源）

definition_zh: 物质主义的；物质至上的；重实利的；唯物主义的
definition_en: believing that money, possessions, and physical comfort are the most important things in life
core_image: 一个人用一堆购物袋堆成宝座，坐在上面数自己的拥有
scene: 一对新人为了彩礼和婚房吵得不可开交，双方父母都觉得对方太看重钱。Tension rose between the two families because both parents seemed far too materialistic about the wedding.
sceneCN: 这里 materialistic 是「物质至上的」（第 1 个义项：认为金钱与财物最重要的态度）；句意：两家父母对婚礼都显得太过看重物质，两个家庭之间的气氛越来越紧张。

pos.zh: 物质主义的；物质至上的；唯物主义的

derivatives.zh: 物质主义者；唯物主义者，由 material 加后缀 -ist 构成，再加 -ic 形成形容词
物质主义；唯物主义，由 material 加后缀 -ism 构成
以物质主义的方式，由 materialistic 加副词后缀 -ally 构成
物质的；实体的，是整族词共同的词根

senses.title: Valuing money and goods too much
senses.titleCN: 物质至上的；重利轻义的
senses.definition: thinking that money, possessions, and comfort matter more than anything else
senses.definitionCN: 认为金钱、财物与舒适比任何别的东西都更重要
senses.example: His materialistic friends only talk about cars and watches.
senses.exampleCN: 他那群物质至上的朋友只谈车和手表。
senses.why: The suffix -istic marks a person who follows a system, here the belief that material things are the highest good.
senses.whyCN: 后缀 -istic 表示「信奉某种主张的人」，这里信奉的是「物质即最高价值」。

senses.title: Characteristic of a materialist view
senses.titleCN: 物质主义的；体现物质追求的
senses.definition: showing or expressing the outlook of a materialist in art or everyday life
senses.definitionCN: 在艺术或日常生活中表现出物质主义者那种眼光
senses.example: The novel offers a materialistic portrait of upper class life.
senses.exampleCN: 这部小说以物质主义的视角描绘上层阶级的生活。
senses.why: Anything that bears the stamp of this outlook can be called materialistic, so the word also describes works and moods.
senses.whyCN: 凡是带着这种眼光印记的东西都可称为 materialistic，于是这个词也用来形容作品与风气。

senses.title: Relating to philosophical materialism
senses.definition: belonging to the philosophical view that only matter exists
senses.definitionCN: 属于「只有物质存在」这一哲学观点
senses.example: Historians debate the materialistic reading of social change.
senses.exampleCN: 历史学家们争论对社会变迁的唯物主义解读。
senses.why: Philosophy first used materialist for the theory that matter is all there is, and -istic carries that technical sense intact.
senses.whyCN: 哲学最初用 materialist 指「万物皆物质」的理论，-istic 把这一术语义完整保留下来。

senses.title: Concerned with physical comfort
senses.definition: caring too much about food, comfort, and physical pleasure
senses.definitionCN: 过分在意饮食、舒适与肉体享受
senses.example: Their materialistic holiday plans centred on hotels and shopping.
senses.exampleCN: 他们过于物质化的度假计划全围绕酒店和购物。
senses.why: Material means the physical stuff of life, so a taste for comfort alone can also earn the label.
senses.whyCN: material 指生活中看得见摸得着的东西，所以单是贪图舒适也会被贴上这个标签。

intro.en: Materialistic is a late compound Latin root with two noun suffixes: material, from Latin materia, then -ist, then the adjective ending -ic.
intro.cn: materialistic 是较晚的构词：先有 material（来自拉丁语 materia），再加后缀 -ist，最后加形容词词尾 -ic。

items.en: Materia means timber, and later matter or subject matter; the origin of the word itself is uncertain.
items.cn: materia 原指木料，后指物质或题材；这个词自身的来源不确定。

items.en: Materialis means belonging to matter, and passes into medieval philosophical writing.
items.cn: materialis 意为「属于物质的」，进入中世纪哲学文献。

items.en: Middle English material enters through Old French, first as a noun for stuff or substance and then as an adjective.
items.cn: 中古英语 material 经由古法语进入，先作名词指材料、实体，后用为形容词。

items.en: The noun materialist appears for those who explain the world through matter alone, and the word soon applies to lovers of wealth.
items.cn: 十七世纪出现名词 materialist，指只用物质解释世界的人，很快也用来指贪爱财富的人。

items.en: Materialistic is formed with -istic, both as the adjective of materialism in philosophy and as a moral criticism of greed.
items.cn: 十九世纪以 -istic 构成 materialistic，既是哲学的唯物主义的形容词，也成了对贪财的道德批评。

items.en: Today the moral sense dominates in journalism, while the technical sense survives in the phrase materialistic conception of history.
items.cn: 今天在新闻语言里道德批评义占主导，术语义则保留在「唯物史观」这类说法中。

note.en: Materialistic belongs to a family built from material with -ist, -ism, and -istic, and its near meanings split by tone.
note.cn: materialistic 属于 material 加 -ist、-ism、-istic 的构词家族，近义词之间差别主要在语气。

entries.definition: substance, or relating to physical things
entries.definitionCN: 物质、材料，或指与物质相关的，是整族词的词根

entries.definition: the belief that money and goods matter most
entries.definitionCN: 由 material 加 -ism 构成，指物质至上或唯物主义的理论

entries.definition: a person who values material things highly
entries.definitionCN: 由 material 加 -ist 构成，指物质主义者，materialistic 正是它的形容词

entries.definition: connected with war or soldiers
entries.definitionCN: 与 material 只是拼写相近，词源来自战神 Mars，词源不同

entries.definition: wanting more money, food, or things than you need
entries.definitionCN: 想要超出所需之物，语气比 materialistic 更直白

entries.definition: too eager to obtain money and goods
entries.definitionCN: 过于渴望获取财物，书面而客观，常见于社会学论述

entries.definition: interested only in money
entries.definitionCN: 只对钱感兴趣，带强烈谴责意味

entries.definition: believing in high principles rather than material gain
entries.definitionCN: 重理想而非实利的，可视作 materialistic 的反义对照

normalIntro.en: Materialistic is a three step build: material, then the person suffix -ist, then the adjective ending -ic.
normalIntro.cn: materialistic 是三步搭起来的：先有 material，再加表示人的 -ist，最后加形容词词尾 -ic。

normal.en: Material comes from Latin materia, which first meant timber and then matter.
normal.cn: material 来自拉丁语 materia，原本指木料，后来才指物质。

normal.en: The suffix -ist marks a follower, as in artist and optimist; a materialist follows material goods.
normal.cn: 后缀 -ist 表示某种信徒，如 artist 与 optimist；materialist 追随的是物质。

normal.en: The ending -ic makes the adjective, so materialism becomes materialistic.
normal.cn: 词尾 -ic 使其成为形容词，因此 materialism 对应 materialistic。

normal.en: Do not confuse materialistic with material, which is neutral; the longer word carries moral criticism.
normal.cn: 别把 materialistic 与中性的 material 混淆，加长的这个词带有道德批评。

normal.en: Compare idealistic: idealistic points to principles, materialistic points to possessions.
normal.cn: 对比 idealistic：idealistic 指向原则，materialistic 指向拥有之物。

abstract.en: Picture a person literally sitting on a throne of shopping bags.
abstract.cn: 想象一个人真的坐在购物袋堆成的宝座上。（对应第 1 个义项：把财物当作最重要的东西）

abstract.en: See a gallery where every painting is priced before it is looked at.
abstract.cn: 想象一间画廊，每幅画在被欣赏之前先被标上价格。（对应第 2 个义项：一切都体现物质主义的眼光）

abstract.en: Imagine a philosopher insisting that only stone and metal are truly real.
abstract.cn: 想象一位哲学家坚持只有石头和金属才真正存在。（对应第 3 个义项：唯物主义这一哲学术语）

examples.en: Many parents worry that advertising makes children materialistic.
examples.cn: 许多父母担心广告会让孩子们变得物质至上。

examples.en: She left the company because its culture felt shallow and materialistic.
examples.cn: 她离开那家公司，因为那里的文化显得浅薄而重利。

examples.en: The essay attacks the materialistic values of the new middle class.
examples.cn: 这篇文章抨击新兴中产阶级的物质主义价值观。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「没貼里」——眼里只剩下钱包里贴着的钞票，别的都不看重，就是物质至上。这只是读音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 materia（木料；物质，自身来源不确定）→ 晚期拉丁语 materialis（属于物质的）→ 英语 material → material + -ist（materialist）→ + -ic → materialistic，核心义「以物质为最高价值的」。

sensesIntro.en: Materialistic has two sides: a moral criticism of people who worship goods, and a technical adjective for the philosophical theory of matter.
sensesIntro.cn: materialistic 有两面：一面是对崇拜财物之人的道德批评，另一面是哲学上「以物质为本」的术语形容词。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a person counting possessions as if the count were a measure of worth.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个人清点自己的拥有物，仿佛数量就是价值本身。

branches.en: Criticism of greed is the everyday moral sense.
branches.cn: 对贪欲的批评是日常的道德义。

branches.en: The adjective can also describe works and lifestyles that show this outlook.
branches.cn: 这个词也能形容体现这种眼光的作品与生活方式。

branches.en: The philosophical sense keeps the word technical and neutral.
branches.cn: 哲学术语义让这个词保持中性而专业。

branches.en: Caring only for comfort is a softer, pleasure-based branch.
branches.cn: 只在意舒适是较温和的、偏向享乐的分支。

branches.en: Both everyday senses blame people for putting things before people.
branches.cn: 两个日常义项都在责备人把物品置于人之上。

intro.en: Materialistic chains three pieces: the root material, the person suffix -ist, and the adjective ending -ic.
intro.cn: materialistic 串起三块：词根 material、表示人的后缀 -ist、形容词词尾 -ic。

latinIntro.en: The Latin base is materia, with materialis as its late adjective; the word buildup happened in English and French rather than in Latin.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语基干是 materia，晚期拉丁语有形容词 materialis；至于多层后缀的叠加，则发生在英语与法语中，而非拉丁语里。

items.example: Material is the base of the whole family.
items.exampleCN: material 是整族词的基干。

items.meaning: a person who follows or practises
items.meaningCN: 表示「信奉者、从事者」的名词后缀
items.example: The suffix -ist forms materialist.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ist 构成 materialist。

items.meaning: a person who values goods or matter above all
items.meaningCN: 物质主义者；唯物主义者
items.example: Materialist names the person behind the adjective.
items.exampleCN: materialist 指形容词背后的那个人。

items.meaning: a system of belief or practice
items.meaningCN: 表示「主义、学说」的名词后缀
items.example: The suffix -ism forms materialism.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ism 构成 materialism。

items.meaning: the belief that money and goods matter most
items.example: Materialism is the belief that materialistic describes.
items.exampleCN: materialism 就是 materialistic 所形容的那种信念。

items.meaningCN: 表示「与……有关的」形容词后缀
items.example: The suffix -ic turns materialist into materialistic.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ic 把 materialist 变成 materialistic。

items.meaningCN: 物质至上的；唯物主义的
items.example: Materialistic keeps both the moral and the technical sense.
items.exampleCN: materialistic 同时保留道德义与术语义。

items.example: The ending -ally forms materialistically.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ally 构成 materialistically。

items.example: Immaterial uses the negative prefix in- before m.
items.exampleCN: immaterial 在 m 前用否定前缀 in-。

latinEntries.meaningCN: 母亲；materia 是否与它同源，来源不确定

definition_zh: 母亲的；母性的；母系的；产科相关的
definition_en: relating to a mother, to motherhood, or to the side of the family that comes through the mother
core_image: 母亲低头把婴儿搂在怀里，一只手托住后颈，另一只手轻拍后背
scene: 她第一次抱起宝宝时，一种本能的温柔涌了上来。As she held the baby for the first time, a maternal tenderness rose in her at once.
sceneCN: 这里 maternal 是「母亲的、母性的」（第 1 个义项：与母亲有关的温柔与本能）；句意：她第一次抱起宝宝时，一种母性的温柔立刻涌了上来。

derivatives.zh: 母性；母亲身份；产科
像母亲那样地；以母性的方式
女家长；女族长
母系的；按母系传承的
已婚妇女；女舍监

senses.title: Of a mother
senses.definition: relating to a mother or acting like a mother
senses.definitionCN: 与母亲有关，或像母亲那样的
senses.example: She gave the child a maternal hug.
senses.exampleCN: 她像母亲一样抱了抱那个孩子。
senses.why: The Latin word maternalis was built on mater, mother, so the adjective names the mother directly.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 maternalis 由 mater（母亲）构成，这个形容词直接指向母亲本人。

senses.title: Motherhood in general
senses.definition: relating to pregnancy, birth, and the care of a baby
senses.definitionCN: 与怀孕、生产及养育婴儿有关
senses.example: The clinic offers maternal care in the first year.
senses.exampleCN: 这家诊所在产后第一年提供母婴照护。
senses.why: Latin mater did double duty for the person and for the whole state of motherhood, and maternal kept both.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 mater 既指母亲本人，也指为母的状态，maternal 把两层都保留了下来。

senses.title: On the mother side
senses.definition: coming from the family line of the mother
senses.definitionCN: 来自母亲家族一方的
senses.example: My maternal grandmother lived to be ninety-two.
senses.exampleCN: 我的外婆活到了九十二岁。
senses.why: Family-line use attaches mater to one parent, and maternal marks the mother half, as a contrast to paternal.
senses.whyCN: 家族支系的用法把 mater 定位到父母之一，maternal 标记母亲那一半，与 paternal 相对。

senses.title: Of mothers as a group
senses.definition: connected with mothers as a group in health or social statistics
senses.definitionCN: 在健康或社会统计中与作为群体的母亲有关
senses.example: The report tracks maternal mortality in rural areas.
senses.exampleCN: 该报告追踪农村地区的孕产妇死亡率。
senses.why: Public health needed a neutral adjective for mothers as a population, and this Latin adjective was the ready tool.
senses.whyCN: 公共卫生需要一个中性词指代作为群体的母亲，这个拉丁形容词正好合用。

senses.title: Instinctive, as if from a mother
senses.definition: instinctive and protective in a way associated with mothers
senses.definitionCN: 像母亲那样出于本能的、保护性的
senses.example: He showed a maternal concern for his younger sister.
senses.exampleCN: 他对妹妹显得像母亲一样关怀。
senses.why: The word can travel from the mother to anyone who acts like one, so the tenderness sense spreads to other people.
senses.whyCN: 这个词可以从母亲本人移到任何做出母亲举动的人身上，于是这种温柔义也扩展到了别人身上。

senses.title: From the mother during pregnancy
senses.definition: passed from the mother to a baby during pregnancy
senses.definitionCN: 在孕期由母体传给胎儿的
senses.example: Doctors checked for maternal blood sugar problems.
senses.exampleCN: 医生检查了母体血糖方面的问题。
senses.why: In medical writing the mother is often the source of a condition, so maternal came to label such things as maternal rather than infant.
senses.whyCN: 在医学写作中，母亲常是某种状况的来源，于是这类状况会被标为母体的，而不是婴儿的。

intro.en: Maternal goes back to Latin mater, mother, by way of the Latin adjective maternalis, where the mother root is tied to the wider family of matrix and maternity.
intro.cn: maternal 上溯拉丁语 mater（母亲），经拉丁形容词 maternalis 而来；母亲词根与 matrix、maternity 同属一族。

items.en: The root is usually reconstructed as mehter, mother, a title found across many related languages.
items.cn: 一般认为其词根可重构为 mehter（母亲），这一称呼在许多同族语言中都能找到。

items.en: Mater means mother and motherland, and maternalis makes the adjective.
items.cn: 拉丁语 mater 意为母亲、祖国，maternalis 构成形容词。

items.en: The adjective enters English from Latin and Old French in the later medieval period, keeping the sense of a mother.
items.cn: 该形容词在中古英语后期经拉丁语与古法语进入英语，保留「母亲」义。

items.en: Medical and family writing fixes the contrast with paternal.
items.cn: 医学与家族文献固定了它与 paternal 的对立。

items.en: Modern English turns the word into a neutral term in health statistics, the mother side of a family, and an instinctive manner.
items.cn: 现代英语把它用作健康统计中的中性术语、家族中母亲一方，以及本能的举止。

note.en: Maternal belongs to the mother family built on Latin mater, and it sits beside motherhood terms and its opposite paternal.
note.cn: maternal 属于以拉丁语 mater 构成的母亲词族，与各类母性词语以及它的反义 paternal 相邻。

normalIntro.en: Maternal is the adjective of mater, mother, and it marks everything that points to the mother.
normalIntro.cn: maternal 是 mater（母亲）的形容词，凡是指向母亲的事物都用它标记。

normal.en: Mater is Latin for mother, so maternal is the mother adjective.
normal.cn: mater 是拉丁语「母亲」，所以 maternal 是母亲形容词。

normal.en: Maternity is the noun that goes with it; a maternity ward is where mothers give birth.
normal.cn: 配套名词是 maternity；maternity ward 就是产妇生产的地方。

normal.en: Paternal uses pater, father; keep the two apart by the vowel after m or p.
normal.cn: paternal 用 pater（父亲）；记住 m 后接 e、p 后接 a 就能分开。

normal.en: Matrix comes from the same root and once meant the womb, a container where things form.
normal.cn: matrix 同根，最初指子宫，是让事物成形的容器。

normal.en: Your maternal grandmother is your mother side grandmother, not your father side one.
normal.cn: 你的 maternal grandmother 是母系那边的外婆，不是父系那边的奶奶。

abstract.en: Picture a mother holding the baby against her chest, one hand cradling the head.
abstract.cn: 想象母亲把婴儿抱在胸前，一只手托住头。

abstract.en: Picture a hospital corridor with soft light, a nurse walking a new mother to her room.
abstract.cn: 想象医院走廊的柔和灯光，护士把刚生产的母亲送回病房。

abstract.en: Picture a family tree with the mother branch drawn thicker, all the names on that side marked maternal.
abstract.cn: 想象一棵家谱树，母亲那一枝被画得更粗，那一侧的名字都标着 maternal。

examples.en: The nurses were impressed by her maternal patience.
examples.cn: 护士们都惊叹于她那母性的耐心。

examples.en: His maternal grandparents came from the north.
examples.cn: 他的外祖父母来自北方。

examples.en: The programme trains midwives in maternal care.
examples.cn: 该项目培训助产士掌握母婴照护。

root: 拉丁语 mater（母亲）→ maternalis（母亲的）→ 英语 maternal，核心义「指向母亲」。

sensesIntro.en: Maternal starts with the person of the mother, widens to motherhood, then labels the mother side of a family and medical or statistical uses.
sensesIntro.cn: maternal 先从母亲本人说起，再扩展到为母的状态，接着用来标记家族中母亲一方以及医学与统计用法。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a mother holding a baby close, her hand steady under the small head.
core.cn: 核心意象：母亲把婴儿搂在怀里，手稳稳托住小小的头。

branches.en: The person of the mother gives the basic adjective.
branches.cn: 母亲本人给出基本形容词义。

branches.en: Pregnancy and birth widen the word to motherhood.
branches.cn: 怀孕与生产把词义扩展到为母之事。

branches.en: The mother side of a family is the kinship branch.
branches.cn: 家族中母亲一方属于亲属分支。

branches.en: Health statistics and pregnancy use the word for mothers as a clinical group.
branches.cn: 健康统计与孕期把该词用于作为临床群体的母亲。

branches.en: Anyone can show a maternal manner, so the tender side spreads beyond mothers.
branches.cn: 任何人都可以表现出母性的一面，因此温柔义扩散到母亲以外。

intro.en: Maternal is built on the Latin mother root mater, and English widens it with the suffixes -al and -ity and with the matri- prefix.
intro.cn: maternal 建立在拉丁语母亲词根 mater 上，英语用 -al、-ity 后缀与 matri- 前缀把它扩展开来。

latinIntro.en: Latin mater means mother, maternalis means of a mother, and the same root produced matrix and maternity.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 mater 意为母亲，maternalis 意为母亲的，同一词根还产生了 matrix 与 maternity。

definition_zh: 注册入学；被录取入学；（名词）注册入学的大学生
definition_en: to be admitted and register as a student at a college or university, often before final confirmation
core_image: 新生在注册台前写下名字，表格上列出每一门课，注册官在角落盖上印章
scene: 这位学生还没报到注册，因为体检结果尚未出来。The student has not matriculated yet because the medical results are still pending.
sceneCN: 这里 matriculate 是「注册入学」（第 2 个义项：在正式报到前完成录取注册）；句意：由于体检结果还没出来，这位学生尚未完成注册入学。

senses.title: Enrol at a university
senses.definition: to become a student at a college or university after being admitted
senses.definitionCN: 被录取后成为某学院或大学的学生
senses.example: She matriculated at Edinburgh in her eighteenth year.
senses.exampleCN: 她十八岁那年在爱丁堡大学注册入学。
senses.why: Latin matricula was a small official list, so to matriculate was to be written into the register of the institution.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 matricula 是小名册，所以 matriculate 就是被写进该机构的名册。

senses.title: Register before final admission
senses.definition: to pass the entrance requirements and be put on the roll before full admission
senses.definitionCN: 通过入学要求，在正式入学前被列入名册
senses.example: He matriculated in the autumn but started classes the next term.
senses.exampleCN: 他秋天完成注册，下一学期才开始上课。
senses.why: Universities kept an early roll of candidates, and joining that early roll was separated from joining the full student body.
senses.whyCN: 大学保留一份候选者早期名册，进入这份名册与正式成为在校生被区分开来。

senses.title: Qualify by passing exams
senses.titleCN: 通过入学考试而获得资格
senses.definition: to gain the entrance qualification by examination, as in older British and colonial usage
senses.definitionCN: 在早期英国及其殖民地用法中，通过考试取得入学资格
senses.example: Few local pupils matriculated that year because the standard was raised.
senses.exampleCN: 那一年因为标准提高，本地通过入学考试的学生很少。
senses.why: When entry depended on a public examination, the verb shifted from registering to passing the requirement first.
senses.whyCN: 当入学取决于公开考试时，这个动词的重心从「登记」前移到「先通过要求」。

senses.title: A registered student
senses.definition: a student who has been formally enrolled on a course of study
senses.definitionCN: 已正式注册在某课程上的学生
senses.example: The hall houses thirty matriculates from overseas.
senses.exampleCN: 这座宿舍住着三十名来自海外的注册学生。
senses.why: English turned the past participle into a noun, so the person recorded on the roll became the matriculate.
senses.whyCN: 英语把过去分词变成名词，于是被记入名册的人就成了 matriculate。

senses.title: Be admitted to a body
senses.definition: to be formally received into an organisation, such as a guild or a naval register
senses.definitionCN: 被正式接纳进某个组织，如行会或海军名册
senses.example: The apprentice matriculated into the guild after seven years.
senses.exampleCN: 这名学徒七年后被接纳进行会。
senses.why: A matriculation book was any membership roll, so the verb spread from universities to guilds and naval lists.
senses.whyCN: 入学名册本是任何会员名册，因此动词从大学扩散到行会与海军名单。

senses.title: Enter a register formally
senses.definition: to enter a name on an official list or register generally
senses.definitionCN: 泛指把名字正式登记进官方名录
senses.example: All new residents must matriculate with the town clerk.
senses.exampleCN: 所有新居民都必须到镇文书处登记入册。
senses.why: The Latin list was administrative before it was academic, and that older listing sense has never completely gone away.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语的这份名册先是行政性质、后才是学术性质，这一更早的「登记」义从未完全消失。

intro.en: Matriculate comes from Medieval Latin matricula, a small public register, which is a diminutive of Latin matrix, a list or roll.
intro.cn: matriculate 来自中世纪拉丁语 matricula（公开的小名册），它是拉丁语 matrix（名册、清单）的指小形式。

items.en: Matrix means a list, a roll, or a breeding female; the word later names the womb.
items.cn: 拉丁语 matrix 意为名册、清单或雌性生育体，后来也指子宫。

items.en: Matricula, a small list, names the register kept by a church, a guild, or a university.
items.cn: 中世纪拉丁语 matricula（小册子）指教堂、行会或大学保存的名册。

items.en: Matriculare means to enter a name on such a list.
items.cn: 拉丁语 matriculare 意为把名字记入这样的名册。

items.en: The verb arrives in English with the university enrolment sense.
items.cn: 这个动词以大学录取注册义进入英语。

items.en: British and colonial schools attach the word to the entrance examination as well.
items.cn: 英国及殖民地的学校把这个词也用到入学考试上。

items.en: The register sense spreads to guilds and official lists, and the noun form names the enrolled student.
items.cn: 登记义扩展到行会和官方名录，名词形式则指已注册的学生。

note.en: Matriculate carries the Latin register root, and it stands between admission terms and enrolment terms.
note.cn: matriculate 带着拉丁语「名册」词根，处在录取类词语与注册类词语之间。

examples.en: In 1922 fewer than forty women matriculated at the college.
examples.cn: 一百多年前，这所学院注册入学的女性不到四十人。

examples.en: Students who have not matriculated cannot use the library.
examples.cn: 尚未注册入学的学生不能使用图书馆。

sensesIntro.en: Matriculate begins with being written on a university roll, then narrows to an early register, an entrance qualification, a noun for the student, and any formal list.
sensesIntro.cn: matriculate 先指名册上写下大学学籍，随后分为早期注册、入学资格、指学生的名词以及任何正式名册。

branches.en: The noun sense names the person on the roll.

branches.en: Guild and civic registers share the same listing image.
